observations: Single photo shows a 4-cylinder engine sitting on a wooden pallet in what looks like a workshop or yard.
Silver valve/cam cover has embossed text reading 'VVT-i' (a Toyota variable valve timing badge), but no engine code (e.g., 1AZ, 2AZ, 3S, 2ZR) is legible.
Engine block and exterior show visible oil residue, grime, and dust; wiring harness stubs are cut and hanging.
No VIN plate, ID sticker, or engine code stamp is visible or readable.
No start-up, compression test, or oil-dipstick shot provided; no documents or import papers shown.

claims.evidence: No shipping label, customs tag, or import document shown in photo 0.
Photo 0 shows visible oil grime, dirt, and dust on the block and cover, not a clean/neat unit.
No video or audio of the engine running, no compression test reading, no oil pressure gauge shown.
No receipt, shop signage, or written warranty card visible in photo 0.

risks.risk: Exact engine code/model cannot be confirmed, so correct vehicle fitment and base price tier are unknown.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the engine code stamp on the block (usually near the block-to-head mating surface) or a legible chassis/engine ID plate.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the lowest-value generic 4-cylinder engine tier, since higher-value codes cannot be confirmed.

risks.risk: Internal condition (compression, bearings, timing chain/belt wear) unknown.
risks.proof: Video of cold start-up with smoke/noise check and a compression test reading.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not tested/running, i.e. worst case non-functional.

risks.risk: Mileage and prior accident/flood history unknown (common risk for 'tokunbo' engines).
risks.proof: Photo of odometer from donor vehicle or auction sheet/import documentation.
risks.if_unproven: No discount assumed, but no premium for low mileage either.

risks.risk: Visible oil residue could indicate an active leak (gasket, seal) rather than just storage grime.
risks.proof: Clean, well-lit photo of the engine after wiping down, focusing on head gasket and oil pan seams.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming possible leak needing gasket work.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the engine code/model stamp or ID plate on the block.
Video of the engine running (cold start) with audible idle.
Photo of any import/customs documentation or auction sheet.
Clear daylight photo after wiping grime off to assess true cosmetic condition and check for leaks.
response.reason: The photo only shows a generic 'VVT-i' badge with no readable engine code, so the specific Toyota model that determines price cannot be identified, and no comparable in the list can be matched without that code.
